direction_protocol.definition: PCA gray and single enclosed-hole axes, modulo180 continuity. Both must agree. Real-history uses previous REAL frame to independent prediction; AR reports local and cumulative separately.
limits: Conservative new visible-axis appendix, not calibrated rigid pose or a change to old formal unknown.
Tiny true or predicted changes, near-circular masks, axis jumps, hole occlusion, clipping, fragmentation and failed true-image calibration remain unknown.
Hole count/area and topology candidates do not establish correct shape, rigidity, collision or the physical cause of a lost hole.

original_noise_layout: Four complete original B4 batches, same original indices0,1,6,7 and16perbatch seeds. No repacking or sibling predictions.
interface_gate: Stop only if actual input/action/timing/normalization/noise contract or engineering integrity fails; model wrong direction alone is not an interface fault.
